purpose: Record explicit user approval of Bella's six MXF FileMobId and MasterMobId reading, selection, normalization and retention rules.
status: Approved requirements; no Bella runtime implementation, cutover or Bin Filter change.

authorization.source: Direct human approval in the current conversation
authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those FileMobId and MasterMobId rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer and MDVX read Clip Name from MXF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Approves the six previously proposed identity rules in the focused MXF identity review. The request to review Clip Name does not approve its new MXF rules or other field/navigation proposals.

agreedBellaRules.fileIdentity: Follow supported typed header metadata, active Preface/ContentStorage membership, EssenceContainerData's LinkedPackageUID and the internal-essence relationship to one unambiguous file SourcePackage with its own file descriptor. Read the complete 32-byte PackageUID; do not select by filename, raw object order or Preface.PrimaryPackage alone.
agreedBellaRules.masterIdentity: Select one distinct qualified associated MaterialPackage whose own supported track/component SourceClip refers to the exact file package and target track. Repeated links to the same master are one candidate. Do not infer a master from arbitrary source ancestry or use object order to break ambiguity. Keep a valid file identity and physical row if the master is unavailable.
agreedBellaRules.normalization: Apply the already agreed shared source-aware Bella normalizer design to the full MXF identities. Convert the documented material fields at offsets 16, 20 and 22 as a 32-bit value and two 16-bit values; preserve label/instance bytes and the remaining tail. Do not reverse the entire ID, skip required conversion by prefix, try byte orders until a match appears or truncate identity. InstanceUID remains a separate 16-byte object-reference role.
agreedBellaRules.ownedStorage: Retain complete normalized FileMobId and available MasterMobId as small owned binary values, with the approved C++17 std::array/QtEndian design and QHash/full equality. Two modern ID payloads total 64 bytes before availability/container overhead. Generate hexadecimal text only when needed; QUuid alone cannot hold the complete MobID.
agreedBellaRules.summaryCopies: Once linked package identities are established, do not retain redundant Avid header summary ID copies or require routine runtime comparison. The agreed baseline uses package relationships rather than summary-only rescue. A proven compatibility variant needing another route requires its own evidence.
agreedBellaRules.temporaryDataAndAvailability: Release object/package indexes, relationship data and header storage after extraction. Retain no complete graph, raw header, second spelling or per-byte evidence solely for IDs. Missing, wrong-width, zero or ambiguous own identities stay unavailable, without fabricated IDs or removal of the physical file. A zero SourceClip reference can normally terminate source ancestry and is not by itself corruption.

unchanged: Use full normalized equality for PMR/MDB/MXF observations.

Preserve approved KelpieId/duplicate rules: same full path plus same complete FileMobId is a repeated inventory entry; different paths sharing an ID keep distinct rows and KelpieIds. A shared MasterMobId does not merge rows.
Keep OldScanner active until explicit cutover approval; Bin Filter remains outside this work.
The approved database-unavailable MXF Duration fallback and blank Original Bin rule remain authoritative.
remaining: Clip Name is the next focused MXF review; its new rules are not approved by this identity decision.
Other MXF field, extraction and navigation proposals remain under review.
Cross-source disagreement priorities, new header-open triggers and MXF concurrency remain separate decisions.
Damaged/ambiguous fixtures, third-party variants, abnormal layout coverage and fresh implementation verification remain engineering work.
supersedes: The proposed/not-yet-approved status of the six identity rules in the 21 October MXF identity review and its research receipt. Historical native, MDVx, current-source and actual-header observations and their limits are not rewritten by approval.
